issues.title: Missing FGGM Order 2 config files
issues.description: The fggm_order2.yaml config was a placeholder with no actual configuration. Created 3 seed-specific configs (fggm_order2_seed42.yaml, fggm_order2_seed123.yaml, fggm_order2_seed456.yaml) with the Order 2 task ordering (NumGLUE-cm -> NumGLUE-ds -> FOMC -> 20Minuten -> C-STANCE -> Py150 -> MeetingBank -> ScienceQA) and identical hyperparameters to the validated default order config (alpha=0.7, lr=1e-5, batch_size=128, bf16, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2).

issues.title: Missing training and evaluation scripts for Order 2
issues.description: No training or evaluation scripts existed for Order 2. Created run_fggm_order2_train.sh (parameterized by seed, launches DeepSpeed training) and run_fggm_order2_eval.sh (parameterized by seed, runs vLLM evaluation across all 8 checkpoints with Order 2 task list and computes TRACE-OP/BWT).

summary: Successfully executed FGGM on TRACE Order 2 across 3 seeds (42, 123, 456) with 8 GPUs each. Training completed for all 8 sequential tasks per seed. Evaluation produced full 8x8 performance matrices. Results: mean TRACE-OP=40.77 +/- 1.06, mean BWT=-3.41 +/- 1.66. Compared to FGGM on default order (TRACE-OP=45.84, BWT=-8.52), Order 2 shows lower TRACE-OP but improved BWT. The experiment was previously unexecuted (config was a placeholder); the optimization resolved this by creating proper configs, scripts, running all training and evaluation.
